sources.title: Russia: Rising Toll of LGBT ‘Extremism’ Designation | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch report (30 June 2025) on the rising toll of the 'extremism' designation against LGBT people: Russian courts have issued over 100 convictions for participating in the 'international LGBT movement' or displaying alleged symbols, with administrative and criminal charges used in a broader crackdown; the text's first page was reachable in the cache (full report is a linked PDF).
